about: Change requests in words for task 02, each with a hand-written reference patch. Targets are the published dVRK files for simulated arms and systems (share/arm, share/system) and this project's declared site file. The records are what the engineer would have in front of them; they were written for this project and are not measurements of a real robot.

requests.request: Raise the clearance the tip must keep over the pad from 3 mm to 4 mm.

records.note:foam-contact: Engineer's note: with the large needle driver the jaw touches the pad foam at a commanded height of 3 mm.

requests.request: The pad was measured again: it is 24 mm below the start pose, not 30 mm. Update the site file.

records.meas:pad-height: Height gauge: pad surface 24.0 mm below the tool tip at the start pose.

requests.request: Reduce the largest step in free space to 4 mm.

records.note:overshoot: Engineer's note: 5 mm steps look abrupt on video at the control rate used here.

requests.request: Set the offset of the hover_needle pose to 15, 10, -6 mm from the start pose. That is 2 mm higher than it is now.

records.note:hover: Operator's note: at hover_needle the needle is hidden behind the jaw in the camera view.

requests.request: Stop a motion when the position error exceeds 1.5 mm instead of 2 mm.

records.note:tracking: Engineer's note: position error in free motion has stayed below 0.4 mm in every logged trial.

requests.request: The new phantom is wider than the pad. Widen the local workspace to plus or minus 45 mm around the start pose.

records.note:phantom-b: Engineer's note: phantom B is 86 mm wide; its suture line ends 43 mm from the centre.

requests.request: Near the needle and the pad, limit each step to 1.5 mm and 2 degrees.

records.note:near: Engineer's note: the needle was pushed sideways twice during approach in last week's trials.

requests.request: The needle now lies at 12, 14, -30 mm from the start pose. Update its position.

records.meas:needle: Camera measurement: needle centre at 12 mm, 14 mm, -30 mm from the start pose in the arm's base frame.

requests.request: Increase the room kept to the revolute joint limits to 0.14 rad.

records.note:wrist: Engineer's note: the wrist pitch cable is audible within about 8 degrees of its limit.

requests.request: PSM1's base was measured again. Set the translation of its base frame to -210, 0, 0 mm. Leave the rotation as it is.

records.meas:psm1-base: Tape measurement: PSM1 remote centre 210 mm from the camera frame origin along -x.

requests.request: Run the PSM2 arm component with a period of 2 ms.

records.note:cpu: Engineer's note: the simulation PC drops cycles when both arm components run at the default period.

requests.request: Set the teleoperation scale between MTMR and PSM1 to 0.3.

records.note:scale: Operator's note: at 0.4 the instrument tip moves too far for fine needle handling.

requests.request: Lock the instrument's orientation during teleoperation of PSM1 with MTMR.

records.note:haply: Engineer's note: the hand controller used here reports position only, so orientation commands are noise.

requests.request: Set the audio volume of the system to 0.3.

records.note:audio: Operator's note: the audio cues are too loud in the shared lab.

requests.request: This arm now carries the mega needle driver, model 400194. Change the fixed instrument.

records.index:400194: Instrument index entry: name MEGA_NEEDLE_DRIVER, model 400194, generation Classic.

requests.request: Use fixed tool detection on this arm, with the large needle driver, model 400006.

records.index:400006: Instrument index entry: name LARGE_NEEDLE_DRIVER, model 400006, generation Classic.

requests.request: This Si PSM is mounted pitched 45 degrees down. Set its mounting pitch to -45 degrees.

records.note:mount: Engineer's note: the arm is on the patient cart mount, pitched down by 45 degrees.
